commentary.description: Recorded as framework commentary rather than a compiled declaration.
commentary.label: commentary

external.description: A linked declaration depends transitively on a project-specific axiom.
external.label: external

incorrect-statement.description: A current-source mistake is documented; the linked valid lemmas do not prove the false clause.
incorrect-statement.label: incorrect statement

needs-alignment.description: A documented gap remains between the manuscript and its linked Lean statements.
needs-alignment.label: needs alignment

needs-review.description: The source changed after a recorded finding; its diagnosis needs review.
needs-review.label: needs review

thesis-only.description: The thesis block is present in the explorer but has no linked Lean declaration yet.
thesis-only.label: thesis only

unknown.description: Kernel evidence is missing, stale, unresolved, or contains an unfinished proof.
unknown.label: unverified

verified.description: Every linked declaration has fresh transitive Lean kernel evidence, with no project-specific axioms or unfinished proofs. Statement alignment requires separate review.
verified.label: kernel checked
